strategies.name: Trend Pullback
rules: Use the closed H1 price versus EMA200 to set direction.
On M15, the RSI(14) pivot candle crosses the prior EMA21 or EMA50. Require a confirming close that reclaims the EMA; RSI pivot range 40–50 for buys or 50–60 for sells.
Enter at the confirmation close; stop distance is 1.5× ATR(14).
London or New York, 08:00–17:00 local weekdays. Skip high-impact USD/XAU news within 30 minutes and require observed spread ≤ $0.50 no more than five minutes old.
Outcome model: M1 bid OHLC, $0.30 assumed spread, $0.05 slippage per fill, 50% closes at TP1 before the remainder moves to breakeven.

strategies.name: Session Breakout
rules: Build the Asian high/low from all 28 closed M15 candles between 00:00 and 07:00 UTC.
Between 08:00 and 10:00 London time on weekdays, use a closed M15 move from inside to strictly outside of the range, in the direction of closed H1 price versus EMA200.

Enter at the breakout close. The stop is the opposite range boundary unless it is farther than 1.5× ATR(14), in which case use the ATR distance. An intrabar test without a breakout can produce PREPARE only.

strategies.name: Micro Pullback
rules: A closed M15 candle above/below EMA50 establishes long/short bias. London/New York weekdays, 08:00–17:00 local time.
On M5 a strict three-close RSI(7) pivot must touch the prior EMA20 on its middle candle. The confirming close reclaims that EMA and moves in the trade direction; enter at that close.
Stop is 1.2× ATR(14). A forming touch can produce PREPARE, not an entry.

strategies.name: Sweep Reversal
rules: A fresh closed M15 candle provides context but no directional bias. Only scan London/New York weekdays, 08:00–17:00 local time.
Use the prior 20 consecutive closed M5 candles. Sweep one side of the range and close strictly inside; skip candles that sweep both sides.
Enter at the reclaim close. Stop one gold tick ($0.01) beyond the wick. A sweep not reclaimed can produce PREPARE only.

strategies.name: Daily Trend Pullback
rules: The closed D1 EMA50 above/below EMA200 sets direction. Decisions are on UTC weekdays.
A strict three-close H4 RSI(14) pivot must touch the prior H4 EMA21 or EMA50 on its middle candle. Enter at the confirming close that reclaims the EMA and moves in the trend direction.
Stop at 2× ATR(14). A forming touch is PREPARE only. Archived H4/D1 buckets must meet the documented price-coverage thresholds.

strategies.name: Channel Breakout
rules: The closed D1 EMA50 above/below EMA200 sets direction. Decisions are on UTC weekdays.
Enter on the H4 close strictly beyond the previous 20 closed candles' high/low, in the D1 direction. The breakout candle never changes its own threshold.
Stop at 2× ATR(14). A channel test is PREPARE only. Archived H4/D1 buckets must meet the documented price-coverage thresholds.
